title: Layer diagnosis: seed-matched audit and intervention preparation
status: CPU analysis complete; GPU interventions not run; no Slurm job submitted
observations: Three-seed MAE is 0.17011 at four layers and 0.17026 at 18 layers; the previous 0.160 full-model comparison was seed 0.
The 1-second SNR difference is +0.01827 with paired hierarchical-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.01988, 0.04996].
The 4/18 cuts change expert capacity from 35.45M to 7.92M parameters as well as backbone access.
Across 9,600 adjacent frame pairs, full-expert cross-seed change correlations are 0.31–0.43.
Upper layers amplify wrist-camera changes and main-camera changes during real placement events. This alone is not a causal explanation of value jumps.
